source_note: The image was frozen before rebasing over unrelated Arcade audit documents. API product sources at main_equivalent are identical to build_source. The qualification commit adds only an oversized-buffer check.

checks.prepush: Normal hooks passed; touched-suite enumeration reached the 120-second cap. Focused checks above were already complete.

Existing linked keys and email L1/strong counts preserved
Storage fault and corrupt/swapped ciphertext fail closed
Merge retains both encrypted aliases and the canonical key still decrypts

protocol_verification.full_generator: Existing environment-access namespace allowlist rejects openagents.environment.accounts.v1 before reaching this profile; no existing contract was altered to bypass it.

verification_scope: Authenticated behavior was exercised through the real API and disposable PostgreSQL. Live staging/production verification covers revision/digest/source, migration readiness, health and anonymous refusal; no physical-phone login was performed in this change.
